chief_data.selection_justification: Selected Candidate 1 as the only viable flow design that meets the intensification mandate (3.0x tau reduction) while maintaining sufficient conversion (X=0.70) and acceptable safety margins. Candidates 2 and 3 were disqualified due to critical BPR violations and insufficient conversion. Candidate 4, while safe, fails the intensification mandate by increasing residence time compared to batch. Warning: no concrete flow advantage identified. This design may not justify flow over batch.
chief_data.selection_rationale: Candidate 1 is selected as the winner with a combined score of 0.730, narrowly beating Candidate 4 (0.718). Candidates 2 and 3 were disqualified due to critical safety violations (BPR < ΔP) and insufficient conversion (X < 0.50). Candidate 1 achieves the required 3.0x residence-time reduction (23.4 min vs ~70 min batch estimate) with acceptable selectivity and safety. Candidate 4 was rejected because it increases residence time (37.6 min), violating the intensification mandate despite higher conversion. The primary uncertainty is the exact selectivity gain at reduced tau, which must be verified experimentally. The first bench experiment should verify conversion and selectivity at τ=23.4 min to confirm the kinetic model.
